title: Dubai Family Holiday
headline: One hotel, a desert evening and park days if you want them.
description: Five nights in Dubai planned for families: a single stay, private transfers and park or desert days added only if you ask.
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type, child ages and which parks you add. Theme-park tickets and international flights sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: A family Dubai that does not try to do every park. One hotel near the attractions you actually want; a desert evening most families enjoy; the rest left open for the pool, fountain or a single park day.
highlights: Five nights in one family-friendly hotel.
A desert evening paced for children.
Park days only when you add them — Miracle Garden, a water park or a major park.
Private airport transfers; no hotel changes.
why: One stay keeps packing off the daily list.
Interconnecting or family rooms requested where hotels can offer them.
Daily load can be cut for younger children.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
One desert evening as specified in your quote
exclusions: Theme-park and attraction tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotel in Dubai
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available

notes: Park tickets are dated and sell out; they are confirmed only in the written quote. Desert evenings depend on weather. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: A single-city family stay. Swap a leisure day for a park when tickets are included.
